history.text: The Okobo Mbawa are the Odu, Eta and Atabong clans; the LGA also holds four of the nine Oron clans. Okobo tradition says Abikot Atipa led their migration from Usak Edet, now Isangele in Cameroon.

summary.text: The Okobo are the people of Okobo LGA in southern Akwa Ibom, beside the Oron. Okobo is a Lower Cross language of its own, related to Oro and Ibibio.

areas.note: Wikipedia's language table gives Okobo for Okobo LGA.
